items.title: AgentSSL: Can MLE Agents Leverage Unlabeled Data?
items.title_cn: AgentSSL：MLE 代理是否可以利用未标记的数据？
items.summary: Applying machine learning systems to new domains introduces bottlenecks in both labeled data acquisition and manual pipeline engineering. While recent MLE agents show promise in automating pipeline design, they have been studied almost exclusively in fully supervised settings, leaving them untested ...
items.summary_cn: 将机器学习系统应用于新领域，会在有标签数据采集和手动管道工程方面带来瓶颈。虽然最近的机器学习工程师（MLE）代理在自动化管道设计方面表现出良好前景，但对它们的研究几乎完全是在全监督环境下进行的，因此它们尚未经过测试。...

items.title: CoReMem: Cost-Internalizing Memory for Successive Coding Tasks with Prospective Valuation
items.title_cn: CoReMem：用于具有前瞻性评估的连续编码任务的成本内化记忆
items.summary: Coding agents tackle successive tasks on an evolving repository, carrying forward edits and writing memory before the next task is known. Selecting memory for unknown next tasks requires balancing future usefulness against the costs of writing and reading it. The actor must also decide when acting o...
items.summary_cn: 编码代理在一个不断演变的存储库上处理连续的任务，在知道下一个任务之前，先将编辑内容和写入内存延续下去。为未知的后续任务选择记忆需要权衡其未来效用与写入和读取记忆的成本。行动者还必须决定何时采取行动。...
